description: Scenario-bounded observational semantic contract for a five-client star topology with one central Pong hub. The contract verifies the untimed bounded diagnostic abstraction, not the original infinite wall-clock periodic execution.

semantic_backend.reason: The contract needs all reachable hub choices, client feedback/drop states, topology-wide routing invariants, and a reachable quiescent state. A single trace cannot establish these properties.

timing_policy.bounded_abstraction: Each client receives exactly one additional untimed PeriodicTick opportunity after Start.

feedback_policy.original: Every Pong causes another Ping to the hub.
feedback_policy.bounded_abstraction: Only the first Pong received by each client produces a feedback Ping; later Pong messages are consumed without output.
feedback_policy.reason: The original protocol is intrinsically amplifying: one hub Ping produces two Pong messages, each of which can produce another Ping. Bounding feedback is required for a finite diagnostic state space.

randomness_policy.original: Random.nextInt selects one client other than the sender.
randomness_policy.target_abstraction: Nondeterministic choice among eligible distinct clients is allowed.
randomness_policy.checked: Safety of the chosen recipient is mandatory. The evaluator also requires positive evidence that the choice is not globally fixed.

representation_policy.names: Exact actor/rebec names are not semantically required. The evaluator discovers the hub from its two-Pong response behavior and derives client roles from protocol traffic.
representation_policy.registration: Explicit Register messages are not required if the target encodes the same five-client hub topology statically.
representation_policy.auxiliary_rebecs: Allowed when they do not change observable protocol behavior.
representation_policy.bounded_state: The target may encode one-shot periodic and Pong-feedback budgets using booleans, modes, or behaviorally equivalent finite state.

excluded_from_equivalence: infinite periodic liveness of the original source
unbounded Pong-to-Ping feedback after the first bounded response

evidence_policy.incomplete_state_space: Do not reinterpret missing positive evidence as an ordinary semantic violation when exploration is incomplete.

tests.description: Each client has startup behavior that emits one Ping to the hub and seeds one bounded periodic opportunity.
Each client's periodic opportunity emits one Ping to the hub and does not recursively schedule another periodic opportunity.
Each client has reachable Pong handling that emits exactly one Ping to the hub.
Each client also has reachable Pong handling that emits no Ping, and no Pong transition emits more than one Ping.
For every observed hub Ping handling, exactly one Pong is sent to the Ping sender.
For every observed hub Ping handling, exactly one additional Pong is sent to a client distinct from the sender.
Exactly five logical clients and one logical hub are discovered.
All client-generated Ping protocol messages target the same hub.
All protocol Pong outputs originate from the discovered hub.
Every secondary Pong target is one of the five clients and is different from the sender of the consumed Ping.
For each client sender, state-space evidence should expose at least two distinct eligible secondary targets, demonstrating nondeterministic rather than globally fixed secondary routing.
Startup Ping behavior is reachable for all five clients.
For all clients, the startup-seeded periodic trigger is reachable and terminates after emitting one Ping.
For all clients, both the first-Pong feedback transition and the later-Pong no-output transition are reachable.
At least one reachable terminal state has empty message queues, showing that the bounded diagnostic scenario can quiesce.
The complete five-client bounded untimed star-topology contract is preserved.
